text_block_list.name: Magazine Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That racing racewear really is wonderful!
The cool, icy design suits you perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her calmly handle the magazine shoot,
I remembered the time we finalized the design for her racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: A racewear design request form, is it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will organize the policy and requests by myself.
...If you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She walked away without changing her expression in the slightest.
She's so capable that I shouldn't need to worry, but still—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, when I headed to the library to look something up—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
Thanks.
choice_data_list: Are you doing some research too?
Are you here to do some research too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Glancing at her desk, I saw piles of books
on color theory, design, and various other subjects.
choice_data_list: Ah, so you were thinking up designs for your racing outfit?
Yeah, I was thinking up designs for the racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That is correct.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Suddenly—among the books she had gathered, one in particular caught my eye.
choice_data_list: The Snow Queen... Do you like this story?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: A tale of bonds, you say...? As if anyone would care.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (I don't like stories. But—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(When I first read 'The Snow Queen'...
I thought it was wonderful.)

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text: A castle... of ice...

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text:
A cold, freezing, lonely place.
No one touches me... no one comes.

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text: ...All alone, this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Young Alv
text_block_list.text:
...
Ice... must be nice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...An impenetrable fortress that lets no one approach.
One that will never, ever melt—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ice...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
This is all I have.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Here.
This is my design request form for the racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Written there was something
beautiful, yet tinged with a certain loneliness—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: Just a hunch, but is it something like that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her way of being—rejecting others and remaining aloof—
I felt as though I was witnessing it anew.
choice_data_list: (Still... I won't let her fight alone.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Um...
Is there something wrong with what's written here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Met with a suspicious glare, I hastily shook my head.
choice_data_list: Could it be... you like ice motifs?
I understand what direction you want to go now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Why?
choice_data_list: Even the "Snow Queen" had an ice castle, after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: …………Not really.
choice_data_list: (…At least it doesn't seem like she hates it.)
(…At least it doesn't seem like she hates it.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Can I go back now?
choice_data_list: Wait! Speaking of ice castles, I just had an idea!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"How about incorporating jewel embellishments reminiscent of ice shards
into your racewear design?"
—I suggest to her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Suit yourself. After all, it's the designer
who decides what gets used."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later—I saw her gazing at the jewels adorning her racing outfit.
Seeing that she didn't seem displeased with them made me happy, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It seems there are no problems, then.
choice_data_list: I think it'll turn out to be a beautiful racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She walks away as if her business is done.
Her figure is truly—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Unwavering, unyielding, and forever stronger than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —From now on too, forever.
